key_finding: Full-length GST-APOOL-His6 bound cardiolipin on an Echelon Membrane Lipid Strip and no other lipid, including phosphatidylglycerol; GST alone negative
context: recombinant human APOOL expressed in E. coli, sarkosyl/digitonin solubilised, dried-lipid overlay
confidence_limits: Moderate for the binding claim, low for mechanism. Whole-protein construct maps no domain or residue. Overlay format with a refolded membrane protein is artefact-prone. Selectivity over PI(4,5)P2/PI(3,4,5)P3 argues against a purely electrostatic polybasic mechanism.

claim_tested: Topology: which face carries the candidate site
key_finding: APOOL is integral to membrane and protease-sensitive like the IMS marker Mitofilin; the paper's own schematic shows two TM helices 'connected by a positively charged stretch of amino acids'
confidence_limits: Supports IMS exposure of the bulk of the protein. Has no resolution for an 8-residue loop, so the matrix placement of 130-137 is geometric inference, not measurement.

claim_tested: MIC27 function in MICOS and link to cardiolipin metabolism
key_finding: MIC26 and MIC27 regulate each other's levels antagonistically and both correlate with tafazzin levels; MIC26 spans the inner membrane and interacts with MIC60, MIC27, MIC10
context: human HeLa/143B cells, co-IP and knockdown
confidence_limits: Indirect. Correlation with a cardiolipin remodelling enzyme is not binding evidence.

key_finding: MIC26/MIC27 double knockout cells have reduced cardiolipin and destabilised respiratory supercomplexes; cardiolipin synthase overexpression rescues supercomplex stability
context: human HEK293 knockout cells, complexome profiling, BN-PAGE, STED
confidence_limits: Cellular cardiolipin level is a downstream phenotype. Does not establish direct binding and cannot localise a binding site.

claim_tested: Where cardiolipin contacts the MIC10 subcomplex
key_finding: Mic10, Mic26 and Mic27 strongly recruit cardiolipin at conserved positive loop motifs, driving oligomerisation and stabilising curvature in model membranes
context: structure prediction plus coarse-grained and atomistic simulation, model membranes
confidence_limits: Independent of this analysis and converges on the same motif class, but is simulation, not experiment. Martini-type force fields over-recruit anionic lipids to basic patches, so it is not an independent experimental confirmation.

claim_tested: Is there a basic/aromatic cluster at the membrane interface
key_finding: Only the 8-residue inter-TM loop 130-137 (RKGSKFKK) is significantly basic-enriched (5/8; Fisher OR=13.70, p=0.0018); the broad matrix interfacial band is not (OR=1.70, p=0.51). Loop mean pLDDT 86.2, flanked by F135 and Y140.
context: AlphaFold model placed in a frame defined by the TM1/TM2 hairpin axis (inter-axis angle 156.3 deg)
confidence_limits: Model-based. AlphaFold has no membrane; the frame is inferred from the hairpin. No experimental structure of MIC27 exists.

stance: supports in vertebrates, refutes the fungal leg
claim_tested: Is the motif conserved across vertebrate and fungal MIC27/MIC26
key_finding: R-[KR]-G-S-[KR]-[FWL]-K-[KR] invariant in character across 12 vertebrate MIC27 orthologs (30-90% overall identity) and retained in human/mouse/cow MIC26 as R-GSKIKK; degenerate in S. cerevisiae Mic27 (NRSNWGAK) and S. pombe
context: Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1, against human Q6UXV4
confidence_limits: Pairwise rather than a curated MSA; fungal sequences are at 13-18% identity where pairwise alignment is unreliable, so the fungal comparison the seed proposed cannot be made confidently.

claim_tested: Do real cardiolipin sites use basic and aromatic residues
key_finding: Arg OR=3.76 (q<0.001), Lys OR=2.40 (q=0.014), Trp OR=2.69 (q=0.038), Tyr OR=2.03 (q=0.073) at CL headgroups; K/R 27.0% vs 9.7% background (p=4.7e-9) but only 0.7% at acyl chains; Glu 0 of 141 contacts
confidence_limits: Crystallographic lipids are a biased sample of high-occupancy sites. Supports residue-type plausibility and the choice of Glu for charge reversal, not the specific APOOL site.

key_finding: No cardiolipin binding or lipid binding GO term is annotated. The only MF annotation is GO:0005515 protein binding (IPI, PMID:25764979). CC includes GO:0005743 (EXP, PMID:23704930) and GO:0061617 MICOS complex (IDA).
confidence_limits: Database snapshot. Shows the MF slot is empty despite UniProt's ECO:0000269 FUNCTION statement.
